description.title: Uranus system barycenter Geocentric Position (geometric vector lane)
description.what: Computes geocentric position of Uranus system barycenter at given epochs. Accuracy reference is JPL Horizons geometric VECTORS (ICRF, VEC_CORR=NONE, Earth geocenter, TT).
description.why: Uranus system barycenter position is needed for planetary observation planning, guiding, and cross-checking analytic ephemerides against JPL kernels.
description.units: Angular separation in arcseconds between JPL Horizons reference and candidate Uranus system barycenter positions.
description.interpret: Lower error = closer to JPL Horizons DE441 ephemeris on the selected lane. Geometric and apparent lanes are reported separately because their model assumptions (aberration / light-time / nutation) differ.

alignment.time_input: JD (Julian Date), TT scale for precession/nutation, UT1 for sidereal time
alignment.time_scales: TT for BPN matrix; UT1≈TT-69.184s simplified
alignment.leap_seconds: not applicable (JD input, no UTC conversion in this experiment)
alignment.ephemeris_source: JPL Horizons (DE441) for reference; VSOP87/plan94/SPK for candidates

library_notes.astropy: The 'astropy' adapter uses public Astropy Time and SkyCoord APIs. Astropy may use ERFA internally, but this adapter no longer calls ERFA/pyerfa kernels directly.

models.jpl_horizons: JPL Horizons geometric VECTORS of Uranus system barycenter (DE441, ICRF, VEC_CORR=NONE, Earth geocenter, TT)
models.erfa: ERFA eraPlan94 heliocentric Uranus system barycenter analytic state minus eraEpv00 Earth state (geometric, J2000 equatorial)
models.siderust: VSOP87A heliocentric Uranus system barycenter state shifted to geocenter, then rotated to ICRS (geometric, no aberration)
models.astropy: Astropy public solar_system_ephemeris('builtin') + get_body_barycentric('uranus system barycenter') - get_body_barycentric('earth') (geometric, J2000 equatorial)
models.libnova: VSOP87 via ln_get_uranus system barycenter_rect_helio - ln_get_earth_rect_helio (geometric rectangular, no nutation/aberration)
models.anise: SPK translation URANUS SYSTEM BARYCENTER_J2000 -> EARTH_J2000 (DE440 ephemeris, geometric state vector)

alignment.accuracy_interpretation: agreement with JPL Horizons geometric VECTORS reference for Uranus system barycenter (no aberration / nutation)
alignment.note: Public geometric lane for Uranus system barycenter — JPL VECTORS (no aberration, no light-time, no nutation). Ranked as best-available model vs JPL reference: libnova VSOP87 geometric path, ERFA/Astropy use eraPlan94 analytic, ANISE uses DE440 SPK when available.
